name: Create a daily habit end to end

payload.text: What habit would you like to build? Send a short name.
How often should you do it?
What time should I remind you? Send it as HH:MM, like 08:30.
What time zone should I use? Send an IANA name like Europe/London, or tap UTC.
You’re all set for Read at 08:30 (UTC). I’ll be here to cheer you on.
